verdict.rationale: Requesty's own docs describe an EU routing option: traffic can go through its Frankfurt (AWS eu-central-1) infrastructure, and all Requesty processing and storage stays in the EU. That gives users a first-party choice of data residency. missing for 10: evidence of regions beyond the EU, documentation of how users select or enable the region, clarity on residency at downstream model providers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Route your AI traffic through Requesty's EU infrastructure in Frankfurt, Germany (AWS eu-central-1). All processing and storage by Requesty stays in the EU.
